entries.zh: 把总（明代低级武官，部领一哨兵众）；此条以之对译西班牙军衔 sargento mayor（军士长，佐营操练、部署队列之职）
entries.en: bazong, a junior Ming military officer commanding a company-sized unit; given as the Chinese equivalent of sargento mayor (sergeant major, officer in charge of drill and deployment)
entries.notes: 官话栏残损且声调多处污损；据西语军衔、汉字'把總'与闽南语 pe chong 三栏互证定义，词头 mayor 经圈改重写。

entries.zh: 游击（即'游击将军'，明代中级武职，统率一路兵马）；与前条把总并列，同为 sargento mayor 词头下第二行
entries.en: youji (youji jiangjun), a mid-ranking Ming field commander; listed alongside bazong as a Chinese equivalent under the same headword Sargento mayor
entries.notes: 官话栏残损；本行系同词头续行，把总与游击位阶悬殊，或系传教士混同华军职级。

entries.zh: 藤（藤蔓、藤条，马尼拉日常贸易货品；sarmiento 本指葡萄藤之蔓枝/接穗）；其后闽南语第二释文残损难辨
entries.en: vine, rattan or cane (teng); sarmiento: vine shoot, tendril or graft scion; second Hokkien gloss fragmentary
entries.notes: 闽南语栏第二释文'cun bu queerui'残损、官话栏亦残；仅 tin(藤) 可确读。

entries.zh: 疥（疥疮，疥虫寄生皮肤所致之痒疮）
entries.notes: 官话栏残损、首音声调污损；sarna 与疥、guey 音义相应。

entries.zh: 疥癣（疥与癣，泛指瘙痒性皮肤病，旧谓'疥癣之疾'）
entries.en: scabies and ringworm; itching skin diseases generally
entries.notes: 官话栏残损、首音声调污损；Sarna 圈出连写本条。

entries.zh: 疥疮（疥虫所生之疮疡；sarna gruesa 谓厚痂之疥）；词头后缀'Haga'义未详
entries.en: scabby sores (jiechuang); sarna gruesa: thick or crusted scabies; trailing 'Haga' unresolved
entries.notes: 官话栏空白且声调污损；'Haga'无法确解，或系旁注连文，不敢强释。

entries.zh: 皮疹、热痱（汉字栏'泖'系存疑字形，按闽南语 pui 当指'痱'一类汗疹；sarpullido 指突发皮疹）
entries.en: sudden skin eruption, rash; by the Hokkien reading pui- likely prickly heat; the character as recorded is uncertain
entries.notes: 汉字栏存疑(泖/㾖)、官话栏残损；据音推为'痱'义，未敢径改原文。

entries.zh: 痱子（'泖仔'为存疑字形，闽南语 pui-giá 即'痱仔'，热天汗疹；sarpullido 之指小形式，整词圈出）
entries.en: prickly heat, heat rash (Hokkien pui-a); diminutive of the rash term, the whole word circled out in the manuscript
entries.notes: 汉字栏存疑、官话栏残损；'痱仔'系据音义推断，原文字形未定。

entries.zh: 串（名词兼量词：串缀成挂之珠贝钱物，可计数；'sartas y numeral~'谓成串可数之物）
entries.en: string, strand (sarta — beads, cash coins or goods strung together); serving also as a count/classifier for strung items
entries.notes: 官话栏残损、首音声调污损；numeral~ 之缩写展开依赖推断（或作 numerales '成串计数'）。

entries.zh: 串成串（如天主教玫瑰经念珠般串缀成串）
entries.en: strung into strings, like the beads of a rosary
entries.notes: 官话栏残损且声调多处污损；闽南语 chia(成)一音经构拟。

entries.zh: 裁缝（字面义'做衣裳之人'）
entries.en: tailor (rendered literally as 'person who makes clothes')
entries.notes: 官话栏残损；西、汉、闽三栏语义吻合，词义本身无碍。

entries.zh: 優（satisfacer 17世纪兼有'使满足、偿付清偿'之义，satisfecho 谓满足者；本条四栏难以互证——闽南语栏仅 iu(優)清晰，其后残损，'tiene lof amenester bona uita'疑系同栏西语旁注而非闽南语）
entries.en: satisfacer: to satisfy, fulfill or pay off (a debt); satisfecho: satisfied, content — here paired with iu 'excellent'; the damaged M-column tail and an apparent Spanish marginal note leave the pairing unconfirmed
entries.notes: 闽南语栏大半残损且混入疑似西语旁注、官话栏亦残；優与 satisfacer 之对应无法确证。

entries.zh: 休（止息、罢休之义；与圈出词头 satisfacer/satisfecho 之对应不明，疑系圈改未竟之条）
entries.en: hiu 'to rest, cease, desist'; its pairing with the circled-out satisfacer/satisfecho is unclear
entries.notes: 官话栏空白；休与 satisfacer 词义对应存疑，闽南语 hiu hiu 本身清晰。

entries.zh: 足（满足、知足；例词'心足'谓心中满足称意，应 satisfecho/contento 之满意义）
entries.en: satisfied, content (chiok 'sufficient, satisfied'); example sim-chiok, contented at heart — satisfecho, contento
entries.notes: 官话栏残损且声调多处污损；例词中 chiong 对应汉字未详（或为'暢'）。

entries.zh: 慊（满足、快意，古义 qiè 读；对译 satisfecho harto 谓餍足之至）
entries.en: satisfied, contented (qian in the classical sense 'content at heart'); for satisfecho harto — fully sated
entries.notes: 官话栏残损、声调污损；慊取'满足'古义以应 harto(satiated)，其闽南语 khiàm 常义另有所指。

entries.zh: 快慊（快意满足；前条慊之并列词，系 satisfecho harto 词头下第二行）
entries.en: pleased and satisfied (kuai-qian); second line under the circled-out Satisfecho harto
entries.notes: 官话栏残损、次音声调污损；与第15条同属圈出续行。
